quickSummary: Master catalogue of real functions: Identity, Constant, Modulus |x|, Signum sgn(x), Floor ⌊x⌋ with Hermite's identity, Fractional part {x}, and Exponential/Logarithmic duality.

conceptBreakdown.heading: 4. Identity, Constant, Polynomial, and Rational Functions
conceptBreakdown.title: 4. Identity, Constant, Polynomial, and Rational Functions
conceptBreakdown.content:
A function $f: A \to B$ is a **Real-Valued Function** if $B \subseteq \mathbb{R}$, and a **Real Function** if both $A, B \subseteq \mathbb{R}$.

1. **Identity Function ($I_A$)**: $f(x) = x$. $\text{Dom} = \mathbb{R}, \text{Rng} = \mathbb{R}$. Line through origin at $45^\circ$.
2. **Constant Function**: $f(x) = c$. $\text{Dom} = \mathbb{R}, \text{Rng} = \{c\}$. Horizontal line at height $y = c$.
3. **Polynomial Function**: $f(x) = a_n x^n + \dots + a_0$. $\text{Dom} = \mathbb{R}$. Continuous and smooth on $\mathbb{R}$.
4. **Rational Function**: $f(x) = \frac{P(x)}{Q(x)}$. $\mathbf{\text{Dom}(f) = \{x \in \mathbb{R} \mid Q(x) \neq 0\} = \mathbb{R} \setminus \{x \mid Q(x) = 0\}}$.

conceptBreakdown.heading: 4.1 Modulus, Signum, Floor (GIF), and Fractional Part Functions
conceptBreakdown.title: 4.1 Modulus, Signum, Floor (GIF), and Fractional Part Functions

summaryBox.title: Piecewise Catalog
summaryBox.takeaway: |x| = √(x²). sgn(x) ∈ {-1, 0, 1}. ⌊x⌋ + ⌊-x⌋ = 0 (x ∈ ℤ) or -1 (x ∉ ℤ). {x} = x - ⌊x⌋ is periodic with T = 1.

conceptBreakdown.content:
1. **Modulus Function**: $f(x) = |x| = \begin{cases} x & x \ge 0 \\ -x & x < 0 \end{cases}$. $\text{Dom} = \mathbb{R}, \text{Rng} = [0, \infty)$.
   - Core Identities: $|x| = \sqrt{x^2}$, $|x| \le a \iff -a \le x \le a$, $||x| - |y|| \le |x \pm y| \le |x| + |y|$.

2. **Signum Function**: $f(x) = \text{sgn}(x) = \begin{cases} 1 & x > 0 \\ 0 & x = 0 \\ -1 & x < 0 \end{cases}$. $\text{Dom} = \mathbb{R}, \text{Rng} = \{-1, 0, 1\}$.

3. **Greatest Integer Function ($\lfloor x \rfloor$)**: $\lfloor x \rfloor = n \iff n \le x < n + 1$ ($n \in \mathbb{Z}$).
   - $\text{Dom} = \mathbb{R}, \text{Rng} = \mathbb{Z}$.
   - Identities: $x - 1 < \lfloor x \rfloor \le x$; $\lfloor x + k \rfloor = \lfloor x \rfloor + k$ ($k \in \mathbb{Z}$).
   - **Hermite's Identity**: $\sum_{k=0}^{n-1} \lfloor x + k/n \rfloor = \lfloor nx \rfloor$.

4. **Fractional Part Function ($\{x\}$)**: $f(x) = \{x\} = x - \lfloor x \rfloor$.
   - $\text{Dom} = \mathbb{R}, \text{Rng} = [0, 1)$. Periodic with fundamental period $T = 1$.
   - Identity: $\{x\} + \{-x\} = 0$ ($x \in \mathbb{Z}$) and $1$ ($x \notin \mathbb{Z}$).

conceptBreakdown.heading: 4.2 Exponential and Logarithmic Dualities
conceptBreakdown.title: 4.2 Exponential and Logarithmic Dualities
conceptBreakdown.content:
1. **Exponential Function**: $f(x) = a^x$ ($a > 0, a \neq 1$). $\text{Dom} = \mathbb{R}, \text{Rng} = (0, \infty)$.
2. **Logarithmic Function**: $f(x) = \log_a x$ ($a > 0, a \neq 1, x > 0$). $\mathbf{\text{Dom} = (0, \infty)}, \text{Rng} = \mathbb{R}$.
- $\log_a x$ and $a^x$ are inverse reflections across the line $y = x$.
